t: A space-themed smartwatch kids can code with drag-and-drop blocks.
steps: Buy the watch from CircuitMess or Ameridroid. Both showed it sold out at 149 US dollars.
Charge it with a USB-C cable.
Install the free CircuitBlocks app on your computer.
Open the CircuitMess guide on coding the Artemis Watch.
Connect the watch over USB-C and pick it in CircuitBlocks.
Try the first lesson to make a simple watch face.
Pair it with an Android phone through Gadgetbridge next.
meta: Open Board. From $149. A few stores.
